national_sources.name: the National Statistics Office of Vietnam

notes.inflation: Inflation is Vietnam's consumer price index as the IMF republishes it: the change in the all-items index on twelve months, and on the previous month. There is no interest rate on this page: the State Bank of Vietnam does not publish its policy rates in a form that can be downloaded automatically, and the Bank for International Settlements does not carry them.
notes.labour: Unemployment is the International Labour Organization's modelled annual estimate, published by the World Bank, not the statistics office's own survey figure. GDP and growth are annual, from the World Bank; Vietnam's quarterly national accounts are not available to automated downloads.
notes.trade: Goods trade is Vietnam's monthly customs data as the IMF republishes it, in US dollars, converted to dong at each month's average exchange rate from the Bank for International Settlements. The Bank for International Settlements has no rate for August 2025, so that month uses the average of the July and September rates. Exports are valued free on board, imports including cost, insurance and freight.
notes.public: Debt and the budget balance are the IMF World Economic Outlook's general government figures, actual years only, so estimates and projections never appear as data.
notes.markets: The exchange rate is the World Bank's annual average official rate. There is no 10-year government bond yield or business confidence index: no free series covers Vietnam.
